description.value: Smitty's is a long-running Canadian casual-dining chain founded in Calgary in 1960, now with over 80 locations nationwide, including this Port Alberni outpost on 3rd Avenue. Known for all-day breakfast and comfort-food classics, it offers a full sit-down dining experience in a familiar, family-friendly setting. For cyclists riding the Alberni Valley or passing through on the way to the Pacific Rim, it is a predictable and filling refuelling stop.

The OSM check_date of 2024-03-21 and looks_closed=false support confirmed-open status. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) appear on either the corporate website or OSM tags, so those fields remain null; the corporate site's 'Order Now' link is the only amenity signal available.
